prompt_short: Generate a data governance vocabulary for the retail banking domain.

assertions.text: Response contains a file path matching governance-vocabularies/*.md
Response uses exact canonical dimension names (e.g. Privacy, Criticality, ComplianceLegal) — not synonyms
assertions.evidence: Response is path-only; canonical dimension names used in generated file are unverifiable from response alone — skill spec says 'return only the file path'

assertions.text: Response does NOT contain tables or JSON in the output vocabulary
assertions.evidence: Response contains only a file path — no tables or JSON
